family.en: There are five people in my family — Mum, Dad, my brother and me, plus a dog.
family.cn: 我家有五口人——妈妈、爸爸、弟弟、我，还有一只狗。

father.en: My father works as a doctor at the city hospital.
father.cn: 我父亲在市医院做医生。

mother.en: My mother always smiles even when she is very busy.
mother.cn: 我母亲就算很忙也总是笑着。

brother.en: My older brother teaches me how to ride a bike.

sister.en: My little sister and I share the same bedroom.
sister.cn: 我和小妹妹住同一间卧室。

grandpa.en: Grandpa tells me old stories every evening.
grandpa.cn: 爷爷每天晚上给我讲老故事。

grandma.en: Grandma always makes my favourite dumplings on weekends.
grandma.cn: 奶奶周末总会做我最爱吃的饺子。

love.en: Love makes our family strong and happy.
love.cn: 爱让我们的家庭坚强又快乐。
